opportunities.point: The company targets reaching closer to a 14% to 15% EBITDA margin in the next 3 years as the share of value-added products increases.

opportunities.point: Management expects peak revenue potential of the Dahej facility to reach INR900 crores during the FY29 to FY30 period.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "I think the INR900 crores that you're talking about should be closer to FY29 to FY '30, that's the period in which we should be able to achieve this number." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project comprising approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum is nearing completion with trial runs scheduled for next month.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Phase 1, comprising approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000-plus metric tons facility, is nearing completion now with trial runs scheduled for next month." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

opportunities.point: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is expected to add approximately 5,000 metric tons and is planned for commissioning in January.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The Naidupeta facility, you're right, it's planned for Q3, but I think it will spill over to about mid- to end Jan. So I think mid-January target. So within January, we will commission that." (concall transcript - 2026-11-01)

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
